label: GO after an unrewarded trial, moderately confident a2 choice at high value
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.9% of mass; never after reward), and almost only when the agent picks a2 (99.9%), mostly repeating a previous a2 (83%). Within that it is selective for a moderately confident a2 policy (logit(a1)-logit(a2) between about -8.9 and -4.4, 90% of mass) and high value-head output (>7.54). It is concentrated in the first ~50 trials of the episode and absent after trial ~80, and is more common when S2 is good or the episode started with S2 good. Never fires at D1 or D2, after reward, or on a1 choices. Predicate uses only observed history plus the model own value/policy readouts (no future variables). Dev F1 0.74 (P 0.65, R 0.87); a superset predicate GO & prev_reward==0 & model_act==2 has recall 0.996 but precision 0.15. Magnitude modulation not checked beyond the coarse bins.
